promises.quote: And we will soon fulfill that promise and have a vote to support our ally Israel.
promises.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BUSINESS BEFORE THE SENATE
promises.why: No bill on it introduced, sponsored or cosponsored, and no vote on it, in 22 months in office after the promise, while other members of the Senate acted on it 83 times. Nothing they said on it since is on file.

promises.quote: later today, I will introduce a bill to repeal the death tax.
promises.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STATEMENTS ON INTRODUCED BILLS AND JOINT RESOLUTIONS
promises.why: Only one bill since the promise, and all 2 of their actions on it went its way (June 28, 2025). One bill isn't enough to call it kept: it's decided once a second bill on it comes up.
